justification: New offline analysis lane (not a production/serving path): a read-only exporter of regulatory_provisions and an offline near-duplicate/contradiction audit over the exported corpus, wrapping enjalot/latent-scope for classifier-QA and canonicalisation. Standard tier because it opens a new DB read path and handles the full provisions corpus, but it writes nothing back to the database, serves no user-facing output, and its artifacts are git-ignored. The whole lane can run egress-free via the TF-IDF embedder.

pre_impl.existing_data: No prior semantic/corpus-level QA tool exists. The prior-art guard flagged frontend provisions APIs (app/api/provisions/*), NumericChecker/numericCompliance (per-property value-vs-control), and the extraction-time markdown parser — all per-record serving/extraction, none a corpus-wide export or dedup audit. Reuse not viable; documented in each script's prior-art-checked line. DB connection reuses services/db_config.get_connection (the established read path); is_current usage mirrors services/shadow_detector.py.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Seeded by a POC that ran the real latent-scope pipeline on 452 Marrickville DCP chunks with a local TF-IDF embedder (Hugging Face egress was policy-blocked). This PR is the committed tooling so it can run against the real 46,585-row table where DB env is set; DATABASE_URL/DB_* are not reachable from the authoring environment.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New analysis-lane capability, deliberately isolated: heavy deps (torch/umap/hdbscan) pinned to a separate venv via requirements-latentscope.txt, never venv_linux. No production code imports these scripts.

functions.name: _build_query
functions.input: council filter list, actionable_only flag, current_only flag, min_chars int, optional row limit
functions.output: a parameterised read-only SELECT string plus its bound params list, ready for cursor.execute
functions.if_none: no councils means all councils; current_only False exports stale rows too (is_current still selected as a column)

functions.name: fetch_provisions
functions.input: the same filter arguments, used to build and run the query
functions.output: a tuple of column names and fetched provision rows read from regulatory_provisions
functions.if_none: connection is pinned READ ONLY before any statement so a stray write raises instead of mutating the database

functions.name: write_output
functions.input: column names, fetched rows, target output path, and the desired format string
functions.output: the path actually written, as parquet or CSV, with the parent directory created
functions.if_none: if parquet is requested but pyarrow is unavailable it falls back to CSV rather than hard-failing the export

functions.name: numeric_tokens
functions.input: a single provision text string to scan for planning numbers
functions.output: a frozenset of normalised value-plus-unit tokens such as 4.5m or 20percent
functions.if_none: text with no recognised number+unit yields an empty set, which suppresses the numeric_mismatch contradiction flag

functions.name: find_pairs
functions.input: a matrix of L2-normalised embedding vectors, a minimum cosine threshold, and a neighbour count
functions.output: deduplicated (i, j, cosine) pairs at or above the threshold, sorted by descending similarity
functions.if_none: uses a cosine k-nearest-neighbour search rather than a full N-by-N matrix so it scales to the whole 46k-row table

functions.name: build_worklist
functions.input: the exported dataframe, the candidate pairs, and a cross-scope-only toggle
functions.output: a ranked dataframe of pairs with contradiction rows (differing numeric standards) sorted to the top
functions.if_none: same-council same-precinct pairs are dropped unless --include-same-scope is passed; empty input yields an empty worklist

values.if_missing: Filtered out at query time (provision_text IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim()) >= min_chars); audit also drops NaN text before embedding

values.read_at: exported column; optional WHERE is_current = TRUE via --current-only
values.if_missing: Column is exported, not force-filtered, so stale rows are visible to the QA pass rather than silently dropped; --current-only restricts to live rows when wanted

queries.purpose: Read-only bulk export of provisions for offline latent-scope analysis; no writeback path exists in the lane
queries.where_clause: provision_text IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(provision_text)) >= %s, plus optional is_current = TRUE, v2_is_actionable = TRUE, and lower(source_council) = ANY(%s); executed under conn.set_session(readonly=True) so no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE can run. Verified live: table has 65 cols / 53,716 rows, source_council holds lowercase slugs

break_it.scenario: Export silently drops superseded provisions, so a QA pass never sees stale data
break_it.what_happens: Mislabelled/stale rows would be invisible — the opposite of the tool's purpose
break_it.how: is_current is exported as a column (not force-filtered); colour-by is_current on the map surfaces stale rows. --current-only is opt-in, off by default
break_it.repro: python scripts/latent_scope_export.py --limit 100 then inspect the is_current column in the parquet

break_it.scenario: numeric_mismatch flag fires on incidental number differences and floods the worklist with false contradictions
break_it.how: mismatch only fires when both provisions carry numeric tokens AND their token sets differ, AND the pair is already above the cosine threshold (near-identical wording); value+unit tokens are normalised (4.50 -> 4.5, metres/m -> m). It is explicitly a review candidate, never an assertion
break_it.repro: synthetic test: '4.5 metres' vs '3 metres' setback pair flags True; identical biodiversity boilerplate flags False

break_it.scenario: sentence-transformers unavailable (HF egress blocked or dep missing) hard-fails the audit
break_it.what_happens: Audit crashes with an import error
break_it.how: --embedder tfidf is fully offline (sklearn only); the sentence-transformers path raises a clear SystemExit pointing at the tfidf fallback and requirements file
break_it.repro: run with --embedder tfidf on a machine with no network

post_merge.manual_verify: Done against production (read-only): scripts/latent_scope_export.py --council marrickville --actionable-only exported 7,577 provisions; scripts/latent_scope_dup_audit.py --embedder tfidf --min-cosine 0.92 --include-same-scope produced 8,261 candidate pairs (1,093 numeric_mismatch) into dup_worklist.csv. Remaining USER step: triage the worklist (top rows include chunking-artifact parking tables) and optionally run the full cross-council corpus.
